page_title: RMA 4-0 OSA | Real Madrid v Osasuna 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' It's a free kick to Osasuna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+2' A pass into the penalty area from Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is intercepted by the defence.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 72462.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
88' Yellow card. Lucas Torro (Osasuna) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
83' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Mario Melero Lopez stops the game and makes a call.
83' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
82' Total attempts – 18:1.
82' Here comes a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Bryan Zaragoza.
81' Here is a change. Jon Moncayola is going off and Daniel Pendin gives the last tactical orders to Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
80' Real Madrid keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vinicius Junior as he is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jude Bellingham departs the field of play to be replaced by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
72' Daniel Pendin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) replacing Aimar Oroz.
71' Here's the change. Ante Budimir leaves the pitch and Moi Gomez (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.

69' 4 - 0 Goal! Brahim Diaz displays great vision and sends a pass to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 4:0.

68' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Sergio Herrera makes a great save to stop his effort.
65' Great save! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Sergio Herrera.
61' 3 - 0 Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
61' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid).
60' Close! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
59' It is time for a substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is on for Ruben Pena.
58' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Real Madrid win a corner.
57' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
56' The free kick will be taken by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid).
55' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
53' One of the players from Real Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Kylian Mbappe is picked out by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.
50' Flag up against Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
48' A precise short pass from Kylian Mbappe releases Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the right post.
48' The ball is cleared after Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Carlo Ancelotti has made a change at the break. Luka Modric has come on in place of Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45+4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45+1' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) stretches for the loose ball inside the box and rifles a volley just over the bar.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! Raul Asencio gets to the ball, slips Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 2:0.
42' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is able to continue to play.
42' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Osasuna is cautioned for aggressive play.
39' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
36' Referee Mario Melero Lopez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Real Madrid players.
36' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.

34' 1 - 0 Goal! Jude Bellingham displays great vision and sends a pass to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the left post. The score is 1:0.
33' An attempted cross from Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is cleared.
32' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
32' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

32' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Carlo Ancelotti is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Eder Militao (Real Madrid) suffers an injury and Raul Asencio comes on.
27' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

27' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
25' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
24' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) was too forceful with his tackle and Mario Melero Lopez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
20' Carlo Ancelotti is forced to make a change. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Brahim Diaz.
20' The game is interrupted now, Rodrygo (Real Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' Sergio Herrera leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
15' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
14' Sergio Herrera blocks a long-range effort from Rodrygo (Real Madrid) towards the left side of the goal. Real Madrid have a corner.
14' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
14' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
13' That's unlucky! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
13' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sergio Herrera intercepts the ball.
11' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Rodrygo with a fine lofted pass.
11' A long pass, executed by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
9' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

8' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows Sergio Herrera to make a comfortable save.
7' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
7' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.
4' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
4' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Real Madrid earn a corner.
4' Rodrygo latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) and heads towards goal.

4' Real Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
3' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends it out of play.
2' It could have been a good chance to score! Eder Militao (Real Madrid) fails to release Rodrygo with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
2' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) tries to find Ante Budimir, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
1' The match has just started.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Mario Melero Lopez will officiate today.
